import uuid
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Depends

from src.modules.shared.domain.entities import TaskStatus
from src.modules.tasks.ports.output import ITaskRepoDep
from src.modules.tasks.presenter.dtos import ListTasksResponseDto, TaskResponseDto

# API sort names (camelCase) → entity attributes
SORT_FIELDS = {"priority": "priority", "dueDate": "due_date"}


class ListTasksUsecase:
    def __init__(self, task_repo: ITaskRepoDep):
        self.task_repo = task_repo

    async def execute(self,
        project_id: uuid.UUID | None,
        status: TaskStatus | None,
        sort: str | None,
        limit: int,
        offset: int,
    ) -> ListTasksResponseDto:
        candidates = {"project_id": project_id, "status": status}
        filters = {key: value for key, value in candidates.items() if value is not None}
        order = (SORT_FIELDS[sort.lstrip("-")], sort.startswith("-")) if sort else None
        tasks, total = self.task_repo.list(filters, order, limit, offset)
        return ListTasksResponseDto(
            items=[TaskResponseDto.from_entity(item) for item in tasks],
            total=total,
            limit=limit,
            offset=offset,
        )


ListTasksUsecaseDep = Annotated[ListTasksUsecase, Depends(ListTasksUsecase)]

def test_list_tasks__sort(client):
    high = _seed_task(priority=2)
    low = _seed_task(priority=1)
    expected = [str(low.id), str(high.id)]

    body = client.get("/tasks", params={"sort": "priority"}).json()
    assert [entry["id"] for entry in body["items"]] == expected
    body = client.get("/tasks", params={"sort": "-priority"}).json()
    assert [entry["id"] for entry in body["items"]] == expected[::-1]


def test_list_tasks__invalid_sort(client):
    assert client.get("/tasks", params={"sort": "notAField"}).status_code == 422


def test_update_task__ok(client):
    record = _seed_task()

    response = client.patch(f"/tasks/{record.id}", json={"title": "Beta"})

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.json()["title"] == "Beta"
    assert response.json()["id"] == str(record.id)


def test_update_task__not_found(client):
    assert client.patch(f"/tasks/{MISSING}", json={}).status_code == 404


def test_update_task__invalid(client):
    record = _seed_task()

    assert client.patch(f"/tasks/{record.id}", json={"unexpectedField": 1}).status_code == 422


def test_delete_task__ok(client):
    record = _seed_task()

    assert client.delete(f"/tasks/{record.id}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/tasks/{record.id}").status_code == 404


def test_delete_task__not_found(client):
    assert client.delete(f"/tasks/{MISSING}").status_code == 404
